about: Declared-part cases shared by the host's test (workflow_declaration.rs) and the web test (requirement-declaration.test.mjs). 'declaration' is the selection row's declaration as the host serializes it for 'text'; 'requirementDeclaration' is the host's one reading of declared against undeclared for the same bytes. The host test recomputes both from 'text' (or 'error') and refuses a difference. Those two are the only values the host's writer test writes. Written by hand, and what the computed values are judged against: 'state'; 'reportStatus' (the requirement report's own declared-part status; null where no declaration could be read); 'toolReadings' (how each declared tool reads, in order); 'toolFindings' (what the host finds wrong with each declared tool, in order); 'reasonStarts' (how an unread entry's reason begins, null for any other state) and 'reasonWhole' (whether that is the whole reason: false where a parser's own words follow). Each declared tool's value is judged against the tool as 'text' gives it. Invented content only.
